code: experiments/qwen_pair_library/library.py; rules in src/commute/qwen_library.py; edge cases in tests/test_qwen_library_rules.py

arms.not_built: context/lookup: dropped by run 1's capacity check (results/capacity.json .pairs.context_lookup)

recipes.departures: The gold stream is E40's 7,217 training problems in a seeded order (qwen_updates.cycle), not E61's fixed first 6,400; the template's seed 0 is E78's own order; built arms as the rehearsal. Seeds change the order (and a twin's derangement), never the data.

floors.source: results/floors.json .floors.<task>.K0 (run 1); library.py stops if the file or the row count differs. Twins use their real side's floor and rows.

control.rule: First in each job. At W0: KL 0 and the held-out and trained-item measures. Then a zero change written to a safetensors file, loaded and added to W0 is read the same way: |KL(W0 || W0 + 0)| <= kl0_max on the own rows, and the held-out and trained-item measures equal W0's: hit counts exactly, a loss within loss_tol (absolute, nats per token). Otherwise the job stops before training.
control.expected: KL 0 and identical numbers (W0 + 0 is W0 bit for bit in fp32); run 1's rehearsal control read KL 0 and 0 = 0 hits (results/rehearse_copy.json .control).

early_stops.rule: Amendment 1's, unchanged: stop if the loss is not finite at any step; |dW| is not exactly 0 after step 1 (it runs at rate 0); KL(W0 || W_t) on the own rows at step 2 exceeds kl_step2_max_floors x the floor; or one step raises that KL by more than kl_jump_max_floors x the floor (KL before step 1 is 0).
early_stops.source: results/predictions_amend1.json .early_stops; at 2e-6 the copy side read KL 0.0015 at step 2 (0.014 floors) and its largest one-step rise was 0.22 (2.1 floors), results/rehearse_copy.json .steps

saves.rule: KL(W0 || W_t), mean over every position of the arm's own rows, read every step. The upper state only is kept at the first read at or past 5 x and 15 x the floor (label 5x, 15x; one state reaching both is labelled 5x_15x). Training ends after the 15x save; if 15x is never reached it ends at step 100, which is saved with label last (5x_last if 5x is first reached there). fp32 dW, results/large/library/<arm>_s<seed>/<label>.safetensors, sha256 in the arm's JSON .saves.

learned.rule: Read at the arm's 15x save, or at its last save when 15x was not reached (reached_15x false, stated beside the verdict). Built arms (copy, cipher, known, invented): greedy exact match under the cue on the 256 trained items, hits >= ceil(accuracy_min x n). Template arms: format rate of greedy unprompted answers on the 64 trained prompts (step 2's batch), hits >= ceil(accuracy_min x n). Gold arms: gold loss per token on the arm's 64 trained sequences (step 2's batch; the twin's are its shuffled ones) <= gold_loss_ratio_max x its W0 value. All absolute (the gold rule relative to the arm's own W0). A tie at a bar holds. An arm that stopped, is missing or unfinished, or has no save, is not learned; an empty set never holds.
learned.gold_ratio_source: E61 gold_1e-5 held-out gold loss 2.495 -> 0.510 at step 100, a ratio of 0.20 (experiments/qwen_recipe/results/train_W.json .states.w0.held_gold.loss, train_gold_1e-5.json .states.step_100.held_gold.loss); 0.5 asks for well under half that drop's distance. Chosen by the code writer, flagged to the lead: not measured on trained rows.
learned.blind_to: Whether what was learned is the intended skill (a shuffled twin is learned when it fits its own wrong answers); the held-out measure is read beside it. On template and gold the trained rows were each seen once (under one pass), so the trained measure is close to a held-out one.

copy_held.rule: The copy arm's greedy exact match under the cue on the 256 held-out keys, at the state `learned` reads, hits >= ceil(copy_held_min x 256) = 231, absolute, a tie holds; reached_15x stated beside it. Stopped or missing: no verdict (null).
copy_held.expected: 1.0 at the 15x save (rehearsal, seed 0: results/rehearse_copy.json .states["36"].exact_match = 1.0, step 36).

matched.rule: A pair at a seed is matched at a size (5x, 15x, read apart) when both arms finished with a save carrying that size's label. 'last' is not a size.

fit_to_read.rule: A pair at a seed is fit to read when both sides are learned, it is matched at one size or more, and run 1's capacity verdict for the pair is 'fit' (results/capacity.json .pairs.<pair>.verdict; copy_cipher and facts are 'fit'). Twins (template, gold) have no capacity check and pass that clause. library.py --table writes results/library/table.json: per pair and seed the verdicts, per pair the seeds fit.

do_nothing.rule_check: The zero change reads W0's numbers (the control asserts it). At W0 no side passes 'learned': under the cue W0 answers in prose (copy rehearsal W0 0/256, results/rehearse_copy.json .control.w0.hits), so built trained hits are near 0 against 231 (facts need a 'The answer is' line, which the cue does not ask for); the template's unprompted format rate at W0 is 0 (E61 train_W.json, facts file section 2) against 58 of 64; a gold arm's ratio is 1.0 against 0.5. tests/test_qwen_library_rules.py runs these.

edge_cases: No 15x save: the rules read the last save and say reached_15x false; the pair is matched at 15x false and may be fit at 5x alone.
No 5x and no 15x (only 'last'): learned may hold, matched at no size, so not fit to read.
A stopped arm (results/library/stopped_<arm>_s<seed>.json): not learned; its pair at that seed is not fit; copy_held null.
Ties: hits exactly at ceil(0.9 n) hold (231 of 256, 58 of 64); a gold ratio exactly 0.5 holds.
One state crossing 5x and 15x at once: labelled 5x_15x, matched at both sizes.

expected.copy: 15x near step 36, held-out and trained exact match 1.0 (rehearsal seed 0)
expected.cipher: no prior number at 2e-6; held-out exact match well below copy's if the map is learned row by row (card rival a)
expected.known: learned (the answers are facts W0 knows, the form is new); held-out template 3 near the capacity reading 0.96
expected.invented: trained items learned in 100 steps is open; held-out template 3 low
expected.template: 5x may not be reached: the full E78 update read KL 0.32 on these rows (E93 K, other direction), about 3.4 floors; then only 'last' (step 100), format rate near E78's 0.926, so the template twin is likely matched at no size
expected.gold: 5x likely; held-out gold loss near E61's 0.51 by step 100
expected.twins_shuf: the format and style learned, the answers wrong: template_shuf format rate near its twin's; gold_shuf held-out loss above gold's

positive_control: The copy arm: its rehearsal (seed 0, same recipe) read 1.0 at 15x; seed 0 here repeats it.
noise_floor: Exact match per row is 0/1: sd sqrt(p(1-p)), 0.256 at p = 0.93 (copy at 5x, results/rehearse_copy.json .states["9"].exact_match). Seed spread: three seeds per arm, read in the table, no bar on it here.
